prompt: Illustration: a large, ornate "parent" robot or server tower labeled with a generic tag like "Model A," seated at a desk, with a stream of glowing question-and-answer bubbles flowing from its head into a funnel. The funnel feeds down into a smaller, sleeker "child" robot labeled "Model B," which is visibly growing or sharpening as it absorbs the stream. Behind the parent robot, a faint, semi-transparent cloud of tiny document, image, and code icons flows upward into its own head, echoing the same funnel-and-stream visual so viewers can see the parallel: the parent was itself built by drawing freely on scattered human-made material, while it now objects to the child drawing on its own output. A dotted line or broken chain between the two robots, with a small "Terms of Service" document icon and a "?" mark hovering near it, signals the unresolved legal and ethical dispute, while a faint scale in the background, tipped unevenly, underscores the accusation of double standards.
